name: Cross-Platform GUI Assembly File Manager
objective: Build a GUI file manager in assembly with Nerd Font glyphs, targeting <500KB binary and <5MB RAM on Linux x86_64
exit_criteria: Build system compiles assembly + Nuklear + sokol + stb_truetype into single binary
Window creation and event loop functional on Linux x86_64
Nuklear GUI rendering displays panels, buttons, and scrollable lists
stb_truetype renders Nerd Font glyphs for file type icons
Directory listing via getdents64 returns file entries correctly
File list view shows icons next to file/folder names
File type detection maps extensions to correct Nerd Font codepoints
Mouse navigation: click to select, double-click to open folders
Keyboard navigation: arrow keys, Enter, Escape, shortcuts functional
Directory navigation: double-click folder, back button, breadcrumbs
Memory usage < 5MB resident during normal operation
